bioconda.name: fmh-funprofiler
bioconda.summary: fmh-funprofiler is a pipeline that leverages FracMinHash (implemented in sourmash) to functionally profile metagenomic samples, offering a faster and more memory-efficient alternative to alignment-based methods.

biotools.summary: fmh-funprofiler is a pipeline that leverages FracMinHash (implemented in sourmash) to functionally profile metagenomic samples, offering a faster and more memory-efficient alternative to alignment-based methods. The pipeline is freely available on GitHub and allows researchers to analyze metagenomic data for functional capabilities.
